{{Quote|Brother, what are we doing here? The Jedi won't be this far in the galaxy.''"<br />"''With the galaxy at war, Savage, there is only one way to get the attention of the Jedi. Slaughter of the innocent. Mercilessly and without compromise.|Savage Opress and Darth Maul|<ref name="Revenge (episode)">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''massacre''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], when the re-emerged [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] appeared in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] once more. He and his [[Brother/Legends|brother]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] sought to draw out the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|crippled]] Maul many years before, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], by massacring the inhabitants of a [[Raydonian settlement/Legends|village on Raydonia]]. The only survivor was an unidentified yellow R4 unit who aimlessly ran into a wall over and over again from either shock or malfunction.<ref name="Revenge (episode)" />
